verses.1: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.2: Say to Elazar, son of Aaron, the priest: “Cast the ashes from among the flames aside. Also, put out the fire, for it is holy.”
verses.3: These sins are committed in their hearts. They have made themselves victims of shame, as if they were to be sacrificed before Jehovah. But they will be sanctified and become an example for the children of Israel.
verses.4: And Elazar, the priest, took the offerings of the priests who had brought them. These offerings were then placed on the altar for burning.
verses.5: Remember, children of Israel, that no foreigner who is not from the lineage of Aaron may offer sacrifices before Jehovah. The sacrifice must not be like ashes or waste matter, as Jehovah commanded through Moses.
verses.6: And all the tribes of the Israelites gathered together from the evening time, along with Moses and Aaron. They said, “You are the ones who have taken over the people of Jehovah.”
verses.7: And in the assembly of the elders, there was Moses and Aaron. They went before the altar. Then, suddenly, a cloud covered them, and they saw the glory of God.
verses.8: And Moses and Aaron went before the door of the Tabernacle.
verses.9: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.10: They were taken out from within that tent, and they ate them for a moment. Then they fell face down on the ground.
verses.11: And Moses said to Aaron, “Take the censer and put fire on it from above the altar. Then place the incense inside it. Go quickly to the congregation. And let them smell the incense, so that the punishment will begin as soon as it is released from before Jehovah.”
verses.12: And Aaron did as Moses said. He rushed into the midst of the people. Then, the sound of crying began among the people. He gave orders to the people.
verses.13: And he stood between the dead and the living. Then the plague was stopped.
verses.14: And there were four thousand seven hundred and fifty dead people in the plague. These deaths occurred due to the plague itself.
verses.15: And Aaron sat down with Moses at the entrance to the Tabernacle. The plague was then stopped.
verses.16: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.17: Say to the children of Israel: Take from among them two dozen bracelets, one for each man, from all their women. Write their names on each bracelet.
verses.18: And the name of Aaron shall be written on the doorposts of the house of their fathers. For one doorpost shall belong to each father’s house.
verses.19: And they were placed in a tent, in preparation for the meeting that was scheduled for you.
verses.20: And the man whom I will choose, his branches will bloom. And I will bring down from above the branches of the Israelites who are now living upon you.
verses.21: Moses spoke to the children of Israel. They gave him all their wives as wives for one man each. In total, they gave twenty-two women as wives for one man. Aaron also received a wife among those women.
verses.22: And Moses laid the tablets before Jehovah in the Tabernacle.
verses.23: And in the evening, Moses went to the Tabernacle. There, he saw that the flowers of Aaron’s family were blooming in the house of Levi. He picked some flowers and threw them away.
verses.24: And Moses brought out all the utensils before the LORD. All the children of Israel saw this, and each of them took one utens with them.
verses.25: And the LORD said to Moses, “Set Aaron’s staff over the congregation, so that it may act as a sign for the children of Israel. Let them carry it on their shoulders, and it shall not die.”
verses.26: And Moses did just as Jehovah commanded him. He acted accordingly.
verses.27: And the children of Israel said to Moses, “We have sinned! We have died; we’ve all died.”
verses.28: All those who approach the tent of Jehovah will die. Will you really go ahead and do this?
